messages:
Mia Chen: Heads-up — Orchard renewal: procurement prefers an enablement credit instead of a straight discount. They say launch timeline is slipping.
AJ Patel: Ok. Do they want credit applied to the renewal invoice or as a future billable?
Mia Chen: They insist it go on the renewal invoice. Target launch 2024-07-15. SSO still blocked (IdP cert mismatch), adoption low.
Sarah Gomez: Adoption note: 60% seats provisioned, ~35% active on core flows. We can run two half-day enablement sessions to accelerate uptake.
Samir Khatri: We have trainer capacity 6/19 + 6/26 afternoons. If we agree to invoice credit we need an SOW amendment and acceptance criteria.
Mia Chen: Procurement proposal: 6-month term extension + one enablement credit (up to 8 seats, two half-days) in lieu of $9k discount. They want the credit applied at renewal.
AJ Patel: Finance: extension ok if we include a minimum committed spend or net-new ARR clause to avoid recognition issues. Otherwise we should consider a prorated seat credit.
Sarah Gomez: Proposed acceptance: trainer deliverables = recording, attendee list, one-page completion checklist signed by customer. Credit triggers only after acceptance.
Mia Chen: Draft amendment language: 
`Customer will receive a one-time invoice credit equivalent to one enablement engagement (up to 8 seats, two half-day sessions). Credit applied against the renewal invoice upon delivery and Customer acceptance of training deliverables (recording, attendee list, signed acceptance checklist).`
Samir Khatri: Add "trainer will not retain customer data; any customer data used in demos must be pre-approved". Confirm trainer availability and lock dates into amendment.
AJ Patel: Legal flagged recordings + data concerns. @legal-bot can you confirm if NDA covers training recordings or if we need a simple addendum?
legal-bot: Standard NDA covers Confidential Information but recordings require explicit consent; I'll draft a one-paragraph addendum titled "Training Recording & Data Use" for the amendment. ETA 3 hours.
Mia Chen: Product asks: customer tied renewal to a CSV seat-mapping import to speed provisioning. Can we scope a small import tool?
Product-Proxy: Product can do L0 scoping today. If effort <2 weeks we can include as part of onboarding and avoid prorate.
Sarah Gomez: If product cannot deliver in 4 weeks customer will push for a 3-month prorated seat credit. We should surface that risk in the amendment conversation.
AJ Patel: I'll run financial scenarios: (A) 6-mo extension + training credit applied now vs (B) 3-mo prorate credit. Sharing numbers by EOD.
Mia Chen: I'll pause countersign with procurement until legal + finance confirm language. If both approve, I'll send amendment + addendum and request countersignature and PO.
Samir Khatri: For delivery: we'll require PO match and acceptance checklist before applying credit to avoid disputes.
Mia Chen: Agreed. I'll attach a template acceptance checklist to the amendment. Thanks folks. :thumbsup:
